# Test fixtures

- `models/burger.glb`, `models/burger.obj`, `models/burger.mtl`, `models/burger.fbx` (binary FBX 7.7),
  `models/Textures/colormap.png`: from the **Food Kit** by Kenney (https://kenney.nl/assets/food-kit), CC0 1.0.
- `models/chair.fbx` (ASCII FBX 7.3 with the exporter quirks handled by `normalizeAsciiFbx`) and
  `models/chair.glb`: from the **Furniture Kit** by Kenney (https://kenney.nl/assets/furniture-kit), CC0 1.0.
- `audio/*`: synthetic tones and noise generated with FFmpeg's `lavfi` sources.
- Images at the root: synthetic shapes generated with sharp.
